tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Which one of the following will react most vigorously with water?

solution.text: Reactivity with water increases on moving down the Goup from $\mathrm{Li}$ to $\mathrm{Cs}$ as $\mathrm{Li} < \mathrm{Na}$ $ < \mathrm{K} < \mathrm{Rb} < \mathrm{Cs}$. This is due to increase in electropositive character. Hence Rb reacts most vigorously with water.
